mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right window style for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right window style involves considering your home's architectural design, your functional needs, and personal aesthetics. Common styles include double-hung, casement, sliding, picture, and bay windows. Double-hung windows offer a classic look and easy ventilation, while casement windows provide excellent energy efficiency and unobstructed views. Consider how each style operates, its impact on your home's curb appeal, and how it will function in each room. Our experts can help you assess these factors to make an informed decision.
